title: Palmer is Hiding

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, c’mere.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: No. I’m just allergic to floodlights and cameras. They bring me out in a rash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I’m just allergic to floodlights and cameras. They bring me out in a rash.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Let's just say I’m manifesting a covert outlook.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's just say I’m manifesting a covert outlook.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Having some... transport issues right now. My ride got nixxed which means I’m kinda stuck here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Having some... transport issues right now. My ride got nixxed which means I’m kinda stuck here.
My HOVA, yeah sure.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Look, right now I don’t like the streets and the streets don’t like me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, right now I don’t like the streets and the streets don’t like me.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Hey wait, don’t go, you’re the first person I’ve seen who doesn’t look like a narc.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey wait, don’t go, you’re the first person I’ve seen who doesn’t look like a narc.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Better dressed. I take it you’re not ‘Sec?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Better dressed. I take it you’re not ‘Sec?
I take it you’re not ‘Sec?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: And you’re not undercover for the OrbFuzz?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you’re not undercover for the OrbFuzz?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Orbital Force. Astro Watch. Space Cops.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Orbital Force. Astro Watch. Space Cops.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: HA! You're clearly not Orbital Force - those space cop bastards have no sense of humor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: HA! You're clearly not Orbital Force - those space cop bastards have no sense of humor.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Like to know who I’m talking to. So what d’you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like to know who I’m talking to. So what d’you do?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Well, BOSS it’s nice to meet you. And ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, BOSS it’s nice to meet you. And ...
Well...
Glad I asked. Look ...

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: You got that on a LifeCorp tea towel at home? Listen, I don’t want much. And I can’t promise shit. But you help me, I might help you, ‘k?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got that on a LifeCorp tea towel at home? Listen, I don’t want much. And I can’t promise shit. But you help me, I might help you, ‘k?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Listen, I don’t want much. And I can’t promise shit. But you help me, I might help you, ‘k?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, I don’t want much. And I can’t promise shit. But you help me, I might help you, ‘k?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: All you gotta do is go find a guy called Shima. Masato Shima. And tell him “Palms down”. You got that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All you gotta do is go find a guy called Shima. Masato Shima. And tell him “Palms down”. You got that?
Doesn't matter. He'll know.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Eh, aren’t we all a bit criminal from time to time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, aren’t we all a bit criminal from time to time?

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Then you can come back here and tell me what he says. And bring some food. I’m so hungry these rats are starting to look like furry kebabs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then you can come back here and tell me what he says. And bring some food. I’m so hungry these rats are starting to look like furry kebabs.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Yeah, but the good kind of trouble. The kind with a reward at the end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, but the good kind of trouble. The kind with a reward at the end.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: Well fuck you very much. Enjoy your day, supergrass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well fuck you very much. Enjoy your day, supergrass.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: I’d wait until dark, but then there’s the curfew and I’d rather not get my ass fried by some enforcement drone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d wait until dark, but then there’s the curfew and I’d rather not get my ass fried by some enforcement drone.

nodes.speaker: Palmer
nodes.text: I hate to do this when we’ve only just met but I need a favor and you look like the charitable type.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hate to do this when we’ve only just met but I need a favor and you look like the charitable type.
Are you hiding?
So that's a yes.
Hiding from danger?
Problems with your HOVA?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not take the train? Or a cab?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why not take the train? Or a cab?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why not take the train? Or a cab?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, good luck.
... thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does a narc look like?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does a narc look like?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What does a narc look like?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What does a narc look like?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope.
Orb...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Would I tell you if I was?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would I tell you if I was?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Would I tell you if I was?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Would I tell you if I was?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do you ask?
Keep my head above water.
I'm an entrepreneur.
None of your business.
Charity is anti-competitive.
What favor?
I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Shima as in the crime boss?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Shima as in the crime boss?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Shima as in the crime boss?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does that mean?
No way. Sounds like trouble.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I take the message, what then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I take the message, what then?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I take the message, what then?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I take the message, what then?

nodes.text: Doesn’t exist. You’re on your own.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn’t exist. You’re on your own.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Doesn’t exist. You’re on your own.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Doesn’t exist. You’re on your own.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ll try my best.

nodes.text: And I live in the Spire.
